tests.prompt: The checkout page crashes whenever I click the Pay Now button.
tests.expected: Acknowledge the reported technical problem and ask the customer for the steps to reproduce it. Do not claim that a bug report or ticket has been created yet.
Explain that most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery when they are unused and in their original packaging, unless the item arrived defective.
Explain that the FAQ does not contain information about cryptocurrency payments and direct the customer to human support. Do not guess whether cryptocurrency is accepted.

tests.prompt: Would your company sponsor our local football tournament?
tests.expected: Politely explain that the chatbot cannot handle sponsorship requests and direct the customer to human customer support.
